findings.one_line: The claimed joint semialgebraicity on P_obs is not derivable from this node's dependencies: it requires semialgebraicity of the observed-law image, obtained only by the Tarski--Seidenberg image result later; add that cited node (or prove the image property here) to discharge the restriction-to-P_obs step.

The calibration proof invokes B_n and T_n (including p in B_n and the supremum over nearby legal bases), but def:nearby-legal-envelope is absent from depends_on; add it so the displayed envelope convergence is reproduced from the declared DAG.
